proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily (refreshed every 24 hours). Flux Schnell costs ~1 credit per image.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides reliable, low-latency API endpoints for Flux Schnell, SDXL, and ControlNet. It completely bypasses GitHub Actions IP blocks and does not require a paid plan to use the daily free tier.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace Pollinations in the `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_svg_pack` workflows to get native 1024x1024 high-resolution outputs with much better prompt adherence.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API keys are tied to a single account; multi-accounting to bypass the 100 daily limit violates their ToS.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 10$ in free starting credits upon registration (no credit card required). Flux Schnell costs $0.003 per image, yielding ~3,300 free high-quality images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Incredibly fast inference times (sub-second for Flux Schnell) with advanced parameters (seed, aspect ratio, denoise). Highly robust API libraries for Python and JS.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into `produce_kdp_cover` and `produce_viral_formats` to get instant, ultra-high-quality graphics directly in the automated pipeline.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the 10$ credit is consumed, it is pay-as-you-go. Must keep an eye on the balance to prevent pipeline failure.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free 'runs' per day on their web app and API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows you to build 'glifs'—which are chained AI pipelines (e.g., LLM prompt enhancer -> Flux image generator -> background remover -> vectorizer) and run them via a single API call.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Perfect for `produce_literal_idioms` or complex card games where you need text, layout, and image generation packaged into one single API request.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Complex workflow UI to configure initially; API documentation can be tricky for custom community-built glifs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 0% platform fee on digital downloads (only standard stripe/paypal processing fees). Unlimited listings. Max file size of 100MB per product.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Unlike Etsy (listing fees) or Gumroad (10% flat fee), Ko-fi's free tier allows digital assets to be hosted and sold with zero listing fees. It acts as an instant digital storefront with no overhead costs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Use as the primary checkout/delivery system for the STL packs, gamedev assets, and SVG bundles generated by the pipeline.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: No built-in organic search traffic like Etsy. Requires driving external traffic (via social media or redirecting from free platforms like Cults3D/itch.io).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload unlimited 3D models. Optional paid subscription tier for your fans (Thangs Membership) with a 91% creator revenue share.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, fast-growing 3D model search engine and marketplace. It uses geometric search, making it easier for users to find parametric or functional STL files.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Upload the outputs of `produce_stl_parametric` directly to tap into the active 3D printing community alongside Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strictly for 3D/STL files. The audience is highly technical (makers, 3D printing enthusiasts).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to submit and download. No listing fees, no revenue cuts.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Assets published here appear directly inside the Godot Engine editor for millions of developers worldwide, creating a high-intent, friction-free traffic loop.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Publish demo versions or free lite-packs generated by `produce_gamedev_asset_pack` inside Godot, then link to the full paid versions on Ko-fi.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Assets must be open-source (MIT, CC-BY, etc.) to be listed on the official library. Best used as a lead magnet.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 500 to 1000 free API requests per month depending on the specific community scraper selected (e.g., 'Etsy Search Scraper').
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Exposes structured JSON data of search results, trending tags, and listing details from platforms that otherwise charge heavily for API access or actively block scrapers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into `agent_trend_explosion` or `agent_opportunity_hunter` to automatically feed trending keywords into the generation pipelines weekly.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Third-party scrapers on RapidAPI can occasionally break if the target platform updates its HTML structure.
